messages.subject: Error in is.geomorph.data.frame(dots[[j]]) :    could not find function "is.geomorph.data.frame"
parts:
Hi everyone,
I am having some problems with just getting geomorph.data.frame to work. I have R version 3.6.0 and geomorph v. 3.1.1. I have the packages installed and loaded as well as the RRPP and rgl dependencies. This is the code and error message I get:

> gpagen <- gpagen(lands, Proj = TRUE, ProcD = TRUE, curves = curves)
  |===================================================================| 100%

> gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(gpagen)

 Error in is.geomorph.data.frame(dots[[j]]) :
  could not find function "is.geomorph.data.frame"


Just wondering what I am doing wrong and if there is another package that needs to be installed/loaded. Let me know if there is any additional information you need to address this question.
Thanks,
Pam

I cannot replicate the error. I am using R 3.6.0 and the latest geomorph and RRPP.

 

I might suggest you re-install from github: 

 

devtools::install_github(‘geomorphR/geomorph’,ref=”Stable”)

 

Dean

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Error in is.geomorph.data.frame(dots[[j]]) : could not find function "is.geomorph.data.frame"
parts:
I think the problem might be that you gave an object the same name as a function and the geomorph.data.frame function appears to try to work with the function called gpagen instead of the object by the same name. 

Cheers,
Mike
